name: icon-picker
title: Icon picker
description: Choose an icon for a project or a list: a searchable grid of the icons you pass in, arrow keys in two directions and every name spoken.
docs: icons is a record of name to icon, each icon a rendered element ({ folder: <IconFolder />, rocket: <IconRocket /> }), so the same set can be passed from a Server Component and from a client module. value is the name of the chosen icon, or null, and onValueChange reports the name; the None cell, switched on with allowNone, reports null. labels gives each icon a name for people ({ rocket: "Rocket launch" }): it is what the search reads and what a screen reader says for the cell, and icons without one are named from their key. keywords adds words the search also finds an icon by. The search matches every word of the query in any order, ignores case and accents, and Enter chooses the first match. The grid is one tab stop: the arrow keys move in two dimensions, Home and End go to the ends of a row (with Ctrl, of the grid), Page Up and Page Down move by rows, and typing a letter on the grid moves to the search. columns is the most icons in a row (6 by default, fewer on a narrow screen); cells are 40px with a 44px target, and the grid scrolls inside the popover without moving the page. The popover keeps 12px from every edge of the screen and, on a short screen, shrinks to the room it has, so the search is always within reach. Name the field with aria-labelledby (the id of a visible label) or aria-label: the name of the chosen icon is added to it, so a screen reader hears the label and the choice together and voice control can say "click Rocket". messages replaces every sentence, name sends the chosen name with a plain form, and open, defaultOpen and onOpenChange control the popover.
